title: “COVID-19 EDA Functions Documentation”
Custom EDA Functions Documentation#This page explains the purpose and usage of custom functions developed for COVID-19 exploratory data analysis in the United States.
1. Data Preparation Functions#renameState()#Purpose: Standardizes state column naming across datasets
Parameters:
df: Input dataframe Description:
Renames any column containing “state” in its name to “state”. Ensures consistent column naming across different datasets.
#| echo: false renameState <- function(df) { df %>% rename_with(~ “state”, contains(“state”)) }

title: Hello, Quarto
content:
Data Cleaning#For a demonstration of a line plot on a polar axis, see Figure 1.
Codeimport numpy as np import matplotlib.pyplot as plt r = np.arange(0, 2, 0.01) theta = 2 * np.pi * r fig, ax = plt.subplots(subplot_kw={'projection': 'polar'}) ax.plot(theta, r) ax.set_rticks([0.5, 1, 1.5, 2]) ax.grid(True) plt.show()
